remarks: Stunning, Fully Renovated 2-Bedroom Apartment in a Charming Victorian Home  This beautifully updated apartment offers the perfect blend of modern luxury and classic charm. The open-concept living area features a cozy fireplace, gleaming wood floors, and a seamless flow into the dining space. The brand-new kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, a sleek marble backsplash, and quartz countertops.  The bathroom is a true spa-like retreat, complete with a marble walk-in shower and custom glass doors. The spacious primary bedroom includes a generously sized closet, while the expansive lower level provides a second bedroom, ample closet space, a laundry area with new vinyl flooring, and fresh paint throughout.  Additional perks include two reserved off-street parking spots and a prime location. Enjoy walking distance to shopping, dining, a new mall, movies, and all that SONO has to offer. Just two blocks from the train station, this is a commuter's dream!  Don't miss this must-see gem!
